plan.concept: A scatter plot showing a dataset with a clear linear trend and several outliers, typical for demonstrating robust estimation algorithms like RANSAC
plan.layout: single panel labeled (a) centered at the bottom

panels.label: (a)

series.label: Data points
series.note: Hollow circles with black outlines and white fill

panels.nodeDecorations: Hollow white-filled circles with solid black borders

plan.colorScheme: Monochrome: white background, black axes with arrowheads, black circle outlines with white fills
plan.reconstructionNotes: The x and y axes must intersect near the bottom-left and end with arrowheads. The data points should be rendered as distinct hollow circles. The label '(a)' must be centered below the horizontal axis.
